svg.title: Token Usage Dashboard Mobile — telemetry
svg.desc: Mobile token usage telemetry: 57.4B tokens, 93.3% cache hit, $56,324.59 estimated cost, peak 5.8B on 06-06. Pure SVG SMIL animation.
